name: Datadog API
tagline: Observability platform API for metrics, logs, traces, monitors, and infrastructure data
description: REST API for Datadog's monitoring and observability platform. Query metrics and logs, manage monitors and dashboards, submit custom metrics and events, and automate infrastructure and APM workflows across multi-site endpoints.

auth.details: API key (DD-API-KEY) required for data submission; application key (DD-APPLICATION-KEY) also required for most read/write API calls. Self-serve signup.

use_cases: query timeseries metrics for a host or service
list and manage monitors and their statuses
submit custom metrics or events from a script
